title: grill-me result
description: One typed turn from the /grill-me runner op (#350) -- the next question, or the terminal proposal that ends the interview. Versioned beside SKILL.md (#41 decision 4). No $schema key: the CLI's --json-schema rejects the draft-2020-12 ref outright. `oneOf` keeps the two shapes exclusive so a model cannot answer with both or neither, and each branch's own `additionalProperties: false` keeps a question from carrying proposal fields or vice versa.

prompt.description: The one thing being asked this turn -- never a restatement of everything asked so far.

recommendedAnswer.description: The answer the model itself would pick, offered as a default -- never invented busywork; the caller may still answer with free text instead of any choice.

choices.description: 2-4 short options. The caller is never limited to these -- free text is always an allowed answer regardless of what is offered here.

summary.description: What the interview settled, in the caller's own terms -- never a restatement of the raw transcript.

verdict.description: Whether the fog this item carried is resolved, or remains -- the caller decides what to do with either; this op writes nothing itself.

patch.description: Editable item-field suggestions arising from the interview. Every key optional -- a verdict of fog_remains commonly carries an empty patch.
